phrase.zh: 学会新的说法，也要听见自己的声音。
phrase.en: Learn a new way to speak, and keep hearing your own voice.

visual.zh: 左侧木底座经弯曲金属颈连接宽大的喇叭口，喇叭朝向右下花篮；细刻线描出花瓣、叶片和编织篮身，上方留出空白。
visual.en: A wooden base at the left connects through a curved metal neck to a broad horn facing a flower basket at lower right. Fine engraved strokes describe petals, leaves and wicker beneath open space.

background.zh:
《窈窕淑女》由乔治·库克执导，1964年上映，并获1965年第37届奥斯卡最佳影片。影片改编自同名舞台音乐剧，故事源自萧伯纳的《皮格马利翁》。卖花女孩伊莱莎向研究语音的希金斯教授学习说话，希望改变自己的生活；训练也带出阶层、尊重与自我选择的问题。喇叭口与花篮相对，取意于她的声音和卖花身份，是原创静物，不是电影帧或原道具复刻；短句为原创。
第37届奥斯卡最佳影片：窈窕淑女。颁奖年份 1965；参评年份 1964。
background.en:
Directed by George Cukor, My Fair Lady was released in 1964 and won Best Picture at the 37th Academy Awards in 1965. It adapts the stage musical derived from Bernard Shaw’s Pygmalion. Flower seller Eliza takes speech lessons from phonetics professor Henry Higgins in hopes of changing her life; the training raises questions of class, respect and choice. A horn facing a flower basket connects her voice with her occupation. This is an original still life, not a film frame or replica prop. The phrase is original.
Academy Awards ceremony 37 (1965), Best Picture: My Fair Lady. Eligibility year: 1964.
